browse.title: Permissions
browse.description: Permissions are auto-discovered from every installed module. Assign them to roles, or grant them directly to individual users.
browse.search_placeholder: Search users by email or name
browse.registry_hint: Modules declare these via ModuleBase.register_permissions — this list is rebuilt from code at every boot.
browse.no_permissions: No modules have registered any permissions.

edit.title: Edit permissions for {role}
edit.description: Toggle the permissions granted to every user holding this role.
edit.empty: No permissions have been registered by any installed module.

user_edit.title: Permissions for {email}
user_edit.description: Grant permissions directly to this user. Inherited permissions come from the roles they hold.
user_edit.empty: No permissions have been registered by any installed module.
user_edit.inherited_hint: Granted by role: {roles}. Turning the switch off here will not revoke it — edit the role instead.
user_edit.effective_no: This user does not have this permission
